scripts.build:artifacts: pnpm build && pnpm build:jupyterlab && pnpm package:vscode
scripts.build:jupyterlab: uv run --group frontend jupyter labextension build frontend/jupyterlab && node frontend/jupyterlab/copy-install.mjs
scripts.package:vscode: pnpm --filter sql-notebook-kit-vscode package && uv run --no-project python scripts/normalize_vsix.py frontend/vscode/sql-notebook-kit-vscode-0.1.0.vsix && node frontend/vscode/stage.mjs
